question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James reported that domestic Private Client Group net new assets rose 88% for the fiscal year to a record of more than $98 billion.
items.quote: Domestic PCG net new assets rose 88% for the fiscal year to a record of more than $98 billion.

items.text: Raymond James reported net new assets for the quarter were nearly $23 billion, with annualized growth from the beginning of the quarter of 5.3%.
items.quote: Net new assets for the quarter were nearly $23 billion, with annualized growth from the beginning of the quarter of 5.3%.

items.text: Raymond James reported record quarter-end client assets under administration of $1.87 trillion, up 1% sequentially and 12% year-over-year.
items.quote: the firm reported record quarter-end client assets under administration of $1.87 trillion, up 1% sequentially and 12% year-over-year.

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said that for recruited advisors coming into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, trailing 12-month production was $538 million, up from $407 million the prior year, and those advisors represented more than $82 billion in client assets.
items.quote: Raymond James reported trailing 12-month production of $538 million for recruited advisors coming into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, up from $407 million from the prior year. Those advisors represented more than $82 billion in client assets
items.scope: recruited advisors in domestic independent contractor and employee channels
